+#!/usr/bin/python

+module: netapp_e_drive_firmware
+short_description: Manage NetApp E-Series drive firmware
+description:
+  - Upload drive firmware and upgrade compatible drives whose installed firmware differs.
+  - Drive firmware must be obtained from NetApp support for E-Series arrays.
+version_added: '2.10'
+author: NetApp
+extends_documentation_fragment:
+  - netapp.eseries
+options:
+  firmware:
+    description: Local paths to E-Series drive firmware files.
+    type: list
+    elements: path
+    required: true
+  wait_for_completion:
+    description: Wait for all selected drives to finish upgrading.
+    type: bool
+    default: false
+  ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+    description: Skip inaccessible drives instead of failing.
+    type: bool
+    default: false
+  upgrade_drives_online:
+    description: Upgrade while drives are online and accepting I/O.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+notes:
+  - Check mode reports planned upgrades without uploading firmware or starting an upgrade.
+  - Check mode requires the firmware to have already been uploaded for compatibility information to be available.
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = r'''
+- name: Upgrade compatible drives
+  netapp_e_drive_firmware:
+    api_url: https://array.example.com:8443/devmgr/v2
+    api_username: admin
+    api_password: secret
+    ssid: '1'
+    firmware:
+      - /tmp/drive_firmware.dlp
+    wait_for_completion: true
+'''
+
+RETURN = r'''
+upgrade_in_process:
+  description: Whether the requested upgrade is still running.
+  returned: always
+  type: bool
+'''
+
+import os
+import time
+import json
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
+from ansible.module_utils.netapp import create_multipart_formdata, eseries_host_argument_spec, request
+from ansible.module_utils._text import to_native
+
+
+HEADERS = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'}
+WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC = 3600
+POLL_INTERVAL_SEC = 5
+
+
+class NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware(object):
+    def __init__(self):
+        argument_spec = eseries_host_argument_spec()
+        argument_spec.update(dict(
+            firmware=dict(type='list', elements='path', required=True),
+            wait_for_completion=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+            ignore_inaccessible_drives=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+            upgrade_drives_online=dict(type='bool', default=True),
+        ))
+        self.module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+        args = self.module.params
+        self.firmware_list = args['firmware']
+        self.wait_for_completion = args['wait_for_completion']
+        self.ignore_inaccessible_drives = args['ignore_inaccessible_drives']
+        self.upgrade_drives_online = args['upgrade_drives_online']
+        self.ssid = args['ssid']
+        self.url = args['api_url'].rstrip('/') + '/'
+        self.creds = dict(url_username=args['api_username'], url_password=args['api_password'],
+                          validate_certs=args['validate_certs'])
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+        self._upgrade_list = None
+
+    def _url(self, path):
+        return self.url + path
+
+    def upload_firmware(self):
+        if self.module.check_mode:
+            return
+        for path in self.firmware_list:
+            try:
+                filename = os.path.basename(path)
+                headers, data = create_multipart_formdata([('file', filename, path)])
+                request(self._url('files/drive'), method='POST', data=data, headers=headers, **self.creds)
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upload drive firmware %s to array %s: %s' %
+                                      (path, self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+    def upgrade_list(self):
+        if self._upgrade_list is not None:
+            return self._upgrade_list
+
+        names = list(dict.fromkeys(os.path.basename(path) for path in self.firmware_list))
+        try:
+            unused, compatibilities = request(self._url('storage-systems/%s/firmware/drives' % self.ssid),
+                                               headers=HEADERS.copy(), **self.creds)
+            if isinstance(compatibilities, dict):
+                compatibilities = compatibilities.get('compatibilities', compatibilities.get('drives'))
+            if not isinstance(compatibilities, list):
+                raise ValueError('Controller returned invalid drive compatibility data')
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. Array %s: %s' %
+                                  (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+        selected = {name: [] for name in names}
+        for item in compatibilities:
+            try:
+                filename = os.path.basename(item.get('filename', item.get('fileName', '')))
+                if filename not in selected:
+                    continue
+                refs = item.get('driveRefList', item.get('driveRef'))
+                if isinstance(refs, dict):
+                    refs = refs.get('driveRef', [])
+                if isinstance(refs, str):
+                    refs = [refs]
+                if not isinstance(refs, list):
+                    raise ValueError('missing drive references for %s' % filename)
+                for ref in refs:
+                    try:
+                        unused, drive = request(self._url('storage-systems/%s/drives/%s' % (self.ssid, ref)),
+                                                headers=HEADERS.copy(), **self.creds)
+                        if not isinstance(drive, dict):
+                            raise ValueError('invalid drive data')
+                    except Exception as error:
+                        self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive information. Array %s, drive %s: %s' %
+                                              (self.ssid, ref, to_native(error)))
+
+                    inaccessible = (drive.get('offline', False) or not drive.get('available', True) or
+                                    drive.get('status') in ('offline', 'unavailable'))
+                    if inaccessible:
+                        if self.ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+                            continue
+                        self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive %s is inaccessible on array %s.' % (ref, self.ssid))
+
+                    target = item.get('firmwareVersion', item.get('version'))
+                    if target is None:
+                        raise ValueError('missing target firmware version for %s' % filename)
+                    if drive.get('firmwareVersion') == target:
+                        continue
+                    online_capable = item.get('onlineUpgradeCapable', drive.get('onlineUpgradeCapable', True))
+                    if self.upgrade_drives_online and not online_capable:
+                        self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive is not capable of online upgrade. Array %s, drive %s.' %
+                                              (self.ssid, ref))
+                    if ref not in selected[filename]:
+                        selected[filename].append(ref)
+            except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. Array %s: %s' %
+                                      (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+        self._upgrade_list = [dict(filename=name, driveRefList=selected[name]) for name in names if selected[name]]
+        return self._upgrade_list
+
+    def wait_for_upgrade_completion(self):
+        targeted = {ref for item in self.upgrade_list() for ref in item['driveRefList']}
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC
+        while targeted:
+            try:
+                unused, states = request(self._url('storage-systems/%s/firmware/drives/state' % self.ssid),
+                                         headers=HEADERS.copy(), **self.creds)
+                if isinstance(states, dict):
+                    states = states.get('drives', states.get('driveStates'))
+                if not isinstance(states, list):
+                    raise ValueError('Controller returned invalid drive state data')
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive status. Array %s: %s' %
+                                      (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+            for state in states:
+                try:
+                    ref = state.get('driveRef')
+                    if ref not in targeted:
+                        continue
+                    status = state.get('status')
+                except AttributeError as error:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive status. Array %s: %s' %
+                                          (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+                if status == 'okay':
+                    targeted.remove(ref)
+                elif status not in ('inProgress', 'inProgressRecon', 'pending', 'notAttempted'):
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive firmware upgrade failed. Array %s, drive %s, status %s.' %
+                                          (self.ssid, ref, status))
+            if targeted:
+                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Timed out waiting for drive firmware upgrade. Array %s, drives %s.' %
+                                          (self.ssid, ', '.join(sorted(targeted))))
+                time.sleep(min(POLL_INTERVAL_SEC, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+
+    def upgrade(self):
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if not upgrades:
+            return
+        body = dict(online=self.upgrade_drives_online, firmware=upgrades)
+        try:
+            request(self._url('storage-systems/%s/firmware/drives/initiate-upgrade' % self.ssid),
+                    method='POST', data=json.dumps(body), headers=HEADERS.copy(), **self.creds)
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upgrade drive firmware. Array %s: %s' %
+                                  (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        if self.wait_for_completion:
+            self.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+
+    def apply(self):
+        self.upload_firmware()
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if upgrades and not self.module.check_mode:
+            self.upgrade()
+        self.module.exit_json(changed=bool(upgrades), upgrade_in_process=self.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+
+def main():
+    NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware().apply()
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+                    raise ValueError('missing drive references for %s' % filename)
+                for ref in refs:
+                    try:
+                        unused, drive = request(self._url('storage-systems/%s/drives/%s' % (self.ssid, ref)),
+                                                headers=HEADERS.copy(), **self.creds)
+                        if not isinstance(drive, dict):
+                            raise ValueError('invalid drive data')
+                    except Exception as error:
+                        self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive information. Array %s, drive %s: %s' %
+                                              (self.ssid, ref, to_native(error)))
+
+                    inaccessible = (drive.get('offline', False) or not drive.get('available', True) or
+                                    drive.get('status') in ('offline', 'unavailable'))
+                    if inaccessible:
+                        if self.ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+                            continue
+                        self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive %s is inaccessible on array %s.' % (ref, self.ssid))
+
+                    target = item.get('firmwareVersion', item.get('version'))
+                    if target is None:
+                        raise ValueError('missing target firmware version for %s' % filename)
+                    if drive.get('firmwareVersion') == target:
+                        continue
+                    online_capable = item.get('onlineUpgradeCapable', drive.get('onlineUpgradeCapable', True))
+                    if self.upgrade_drives_online and not online_capable:
+                        self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive is not capable of online upgrade. Array %s, drive %s.' %
+                                              (self.ssid, ref))
+                    if ref not in selected[filename]:
+                        selected[filename].append(ref)
+            except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. Array %s: %s' %
+                                      (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+        self._upgrade_list = [dict(filename=name, driveRefList=selected[name]) for name in names if selected[name]]
+        return self._upgrade_list
+
+    def wait_for_upgrade_completion(self):
+        targeted = {ref for item in self.upgrade_list() for ref in item['driveRefList']}
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC
+        while targeted:
+            try:
+                unused, states = request(self._url('storage-systems/%s/firmware/drives/state' % self.ssid),
+                                         headers=HEADERS.copy(), **self.creds)
+                if isinstance(states, dict):
+                    states = states.get('drives', states.get('driveStates'))
+                if not isinstance(states, list):
+                    raise ValueError('Controller returned invalid drive state data')
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive status. Array %s: %s' %
+                                      (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+            for state in states:
+                try:
+                    ref = state.get('driveRef')
+                    if ref not in targeted:
+                        continue
+                    status = state.get('status')
+                except AttributeError as error:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive status. Array %s: %s' %
+                                          (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+                if status == 'okay':
+                    targeted.remove(ref)
+                elif status not in ('inProgress', 'inProgressRecon', 'pending', 'notAttempted'):
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive firmware upgrade failed. Array %s, drive %s, status %s.' %
+                                          (self.ssid, ref, status))
+            if targeted:
+                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Timed out waiting for drive firmware upgrade. Array %s, drives %s.' %
+                                          (self.ssid, ', '.join(sorted(targeted))))
+                time.sleep(min(POLL_INTERVAL_SEC, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+
+    def upgrade(self):
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if not upgrades:
+            return
+        body = dict(online=self.upgrade_drives_online, firmware=upgrades)
+        try:
+            request(self._url('storage-systems/%s/firmware/drives/initiate-upgrade' % self.ssid),
+                    method='POST', data=json.dumps(body), headers=HEADERS.copy(), **self.creds)
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upgrade drive firmware. Array %s: %s' %
+                                  (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        if self.wait_for_completion:
+            self.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+
+    def apply(self):
+        self.upload_firmware()
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if upgrades and not self.module.check_mode:
+            self.upgrade()
+        self.module.exit_json(changed=bool(upgrades), upgrade_in_process=self.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+
+def main():
+    NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware().apply()
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
